messages:
maria: Heads-up — noticed the quota dashboard is undercounting requests for some tenants when clients don't send route metadata. Seems tied to the SDKs not setting the new debug header.

josh: re: which header? we intentionally avoided auto-adding anything that could leak internal route ids.

maria: the opt-in header I mean is X-Redwood-Quota-Debug (boolean true). only meant for dev/debug mode; server-side we use it to include the raw route-hint in the quota attribution path so the console can reconcile spikes. not intended for prod usage.

samir: curious — if it's opt-in, is the plan to ship in all SDKS behind a feature flag or expose it as a client config?

maria: feature-flagged, yes. devex proposal: default off, docs show how to enable per-client. rollout via canary: set header in 5% of dev accounts, monitor console diffs.

josh: security question: could this header accidentally contain customer-identifiable metadata? Manuel?
\manuel: good call. header should be sanitized on the SDK side; only allow route tags we control (route:service, route:env). strip anything else. server will ignore unknown keys.

elaine: product + console UX ask — can Dev Console add a toggle to show "raw attribution" vs "normalized attribution" in the quota view? That'll help teams see why the numbers differ.

maria: yes, we can add toggle. UX: brief banner when raw view is on that it is a debug trace and may expose route hints.

samir: metrics/telemetry: adding header will inflate tag cardinality unless we bucket. we should hash route-hint prior to emitting to metrics and only keep unhashed value in trace logs for a short retention.

josh: agreed. also set sampling to 1% for production canary, 10% for dev orgs. put that in the rollout playbook.

maria: sample playbook snippet: 
```
# python example (dev mode)
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'), dev_debug=True)
# sets X-Redwood-Quota-Debug: true (sanitized)
```

elaine: timeline request: want console toggle in next sprint to pair with canary. Can backend and SDKS have a beta flag this week?

josh: backend change (proxy + attribution pipeline) is small — we can land a PR and deploy behind a feature flag. SDKS: need small patch in python/ts/go to add header behind client config. estimate 2-3 days across languages.

manuel: ops note — we'll add a deploy-bot job to flip the proxy flag per namespace; keep observability hooks so we can rollback quickly.

deploy-bot: deploy plan created: quota-debug-proxy-ff -> namespace canaries, initial 1% sampling, linked to console feature flag.

maria: blockers?

samir: none besides telemetry backfill plan. i'll create an issue to hash+bucket route tags and set retention for unhashed traces (168h).

josh: i'll open SDK PRs and add README docs for opt-in. please add a short deprecation note: if we later promote to automatic routing, teams will be notified 30d ahead.
\maria: perfect. I'll sync with product on messaging and add the console toggle ticket. thanks all :thumbsup:

manuel: +1, will watch the canary dashboards.

elaine: thanks team — ping me when console PR is up and I'll validate UX copy.

maria: filing follow-ups: 1) telemetry issue (samir), 2) SDK PRs (josh), 3) console toggle ticket (elaine), 4) ops deploy job (manuel).
